learning_outcomes.text: The student knows basic economic concepts and the equivalents of terms used in daily life.
The student will able to use engineering economics principles in the project evaluation and decision-making process.
The student will know the time value of money and will be able to prepare the project cash flow.
The student will able to make an economic analysis of the project.
The student will able to evaluate the feasibility of the project and decide.

syllabus_topics: Information about the course, Introduction, Definition of economics, Basic economic concepts. Factors of production. Engineering economics and its content.
Basic economic concepts (inflation, stagnation, etc.). Law of demand, demand function, demand curve, demand shift.
Capacity and efficiency concept and analysis. Cost concept, classification and analysis.
Cost analysis, Revenue - Profit concepts and analysis, Profit, Profit maximization and break-even analysis.
Profit maximization and break-even analysis, Accounting and engineering economics, Financial statements: Balance sheet and Income statement analysis. Operating leverage.
Exam evaluation, time value of money.
Time value of money, concept of interest, nominal interest, effective interest.
Annuities, future value, present value, loan payments.
Project evaluation methods: net present value analysis, internal rate of return, benefit cost analysis, profitability index, and applications.
Dependent and independent project concepts and analysis, Dependent Project evaluation methods and its application.
General review, practice, questions and answers, general exam preparation.
